name: adhd-one
description: An unofficial, batteries-included Windows desktop for DeepSeek Harness.
author: xydadada

scripts.start: npm run prepare-electron && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run generate-icons && npm run build:app && electron .
scripts.smoke: npm run prepare-electron && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run generate-icons && npm run build:app && node scripts/smoke-app.mjs
scripts.test:runtime: vitest run test/windows-platform.test.ts test/security.test.ts test/settings-store.test.ts test/data-migration.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run
scripts.license:closure:gate: npm run license:closure && npm run license:closure:check
scripts.audit:signatures: npm audit signatures && npm audit signatures --prefix runtime
scripts.package:setup:prepared: npm run check:syntax && electron-builder --config build/setup.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/generate-license-closure.mjs --check --package-root dist/win-unpacked && npm run verify:package-closure -- dist/win-unpacked --mode setup
scripts.package:portable:prepared: npm run check:syntax && electron-builder --config build/portable.yml --win zip --x64 --publish never && node scripts/generate-license-closure.mjs --check --package-root dist/win-unpacked && npm run verify:package-closure -- dist/win-unpacked --mode portable
scripts.build:setup: npm run prepare-electron && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run prepare-runtime-archive && npm run generate-icons && npm run build:app && npm run license:closure:gate && npm run package:setup:prepared
scripts.build:portable: npm run prepare-electron && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run prepare-runtime-archive && npm run generate-icons && npm run build:app && npm run license:closure:gate && npm run package:portable:prepared
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare-electron && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run prepare-runtime-archive && npm run generate-icons && npm run build:app && npm run license:closure:gate && npm run package:setup:prepared && npm run package:portable:prepared
